body:
## Why

In tools/embedding_provider.py lines 155 and 214, both OpenAIEmbeddingProvider.embed and LocalFallbackEmbeddingProvider.embed filter input texts using list comprehensions: items = [text.strip() for text in texts if text and text.strip()]. When a caller provides an iterable containing empty or whitespace-only strings (e.g. ["text", "", "more"]), dropping elements changes the returned vector count (len(response.vectors) != len(texts)), corrupting positional 1-to-1 alignment between input documents and output embedding vectors.

## Scope

- Update embed in tools/embedding_provider.py across provider implementations to maintain index-aligned output vectors for all input elements.
- Add unit test coverage in tests/test_main.py verifying sequence length and positional alignment when empty strings are provided.

## Non-Goals

- Modifying embedding dimensions or vector normalization math in LocalFallbackEmbeddingProvider.
- Changing exception handling for missing API keys.
- Scaffold-only completion does NOT count: raising an exception on empty strings instead of returning aligned vector responses is a failure of this issue.

## Tasks

- [ ] Update OpenAIEmbeddingProvider.embed in tools/embedding_provider.py to preserve input sequence length
- [ ] Update LocalFallbackEmbeddingProvider.embed in tools/embedding_provider.py to return a zero or fallback vector for empty items
- [ ] Add unit tests in tests/test_main.py asserting len(resp.vectors) == len(texts) for inputs containing empty strings

## Acceptance Criteria

- `pytest tests/test_main.py` passes with all tests green.
- `python -c "from tools.embedding_provider import LocalFallbackEmbeddingProvider; p = LocalFallbackEmbeddingProvider(); r = p.embed(['a', '', 'b']); assert len(r.vectors) == 3"` succeeds.
- Deliberate-break demonstration: re-introducing the if text.strip() filter causes `pytest tests/test_main.py` to fail on empty-item test cases, and reverting restores pass.

## Implementation Notes

References: Code/Audits/Ready/2026-09-07-00-repo-map.md.
Ensure fallback vectors for empty items are finite normalized float vectors or zero vectors.
title: [P1] Preserve input sequence length on empty strings in embedding providers
